Most people are completely missing the scale of the opportunity currently sitting on GalaSwap. Let’s break it down:

Think of GalaSwap as a vast, newly opened map with 2,000 prime plots of digital real estate. How do we get that number? Take the top ~500 most traded tokens and pair them against the four market heavyweights: BTC, ETH, USDT, and USDC.

The "Wide Open" Opportunity
Here is the crazy part: today, only a few dozen of those 2,000 pools have been established. The rest is completely untouched territory. There are over 1,900 viable markets just waiting for someone to build them.

Why Being First Pays Off
If you provide liquidity to a pool that already exists, you are just renting space—splitting the trading fees with everyone else in the crowd.

This month, we’re going to explore this wide-open frontier. We'll look at which empty spaces have the highest pent-up demand, how much volume they can hold, and exactly how you can plant your flag.

🚀 Russian Ballistic Missile Reportedly Destroys Drone Factory in Kyiv
 
A drone manufacturing facility in Kyiv was destroyed in a Russian ballistic missile strike on Friday. According to reports, the factory was owned by Terminal Autonomy, a U.S.-registered company incorporated in Delaware, marking what has been described as the first reported strike on a U.S.-owned company during the conflict.
 
Terminal Autonomy develops AI-assisted deep-strike drones equipped with guidance systems designed to remain operational despite electronic jamming. The company says its loitering munitions and precision weapons are already being used on the front line.
 
The company and Ukraine's Ministry of Defense did not comment on the reports.
 
Former U.S. intelligence official Anthony Vinci said ownership of a manufacturing facility is unlikely to influence Russian targeting decisions if the site is considered to have military significance.
The strike comes amid continued debate over expanding defense production in Ukraine. Earlier this month, U.S. President Donald Trump said the United States would authorize licensed production of Patriot air-defense missiles in Ukraine. Vinci suggested that facilities manufacturing U.S.-designed military systems could also become potential targets.
According to reports, no casualties were recorded in the attack.

🔔 Ethereum price faces $2,000 test as oil surge revives rate fears 

⚡️ Ethereum price has remained trapped below $2,000 as rising oil prices, renewed interest-rate concerns and BitMEX’s planned shutdown have tempered bullish sentiment despite continued spot ETF inflows. According to data from cryptonews, Ethereum price traded near $1,927 on July 23 after reaching an intraday high of $1,941. The token has recovered more than 27% from its June low near $1,514, but repeated failures around $1,955 have kept the psychological $2,000 level beyond buyers’ reach.

🔗 Rate traders have already adjusted their positions. The probability of a September Fed hike rose to 79% from 68% per data from the CME FedWatch tool. Expectations for the July meeting remain centered on no change, but another oil-led inflation increase could lift Treasury yields and pressure risk assets such as Ethereum. 

🔖 U.S. equities also weakened after Alphabet raised its 2026 capital-spending forecast to between $195 billion and $205 billion. The company recorded negative free cash flow of $5.9 billion as quarterly expenditure doubled to $44.9 billion, while its shares fell in premarket trading.
